_about: One real probe of every candidate feed. kept=false means the feed did not answer, carried no items, carried no usable article link, or robots.txt refuses us the feed or the article path on this date - those entries were removed from config/publisher-feeds.json and this file is the record of why. One thing here is not the byte the probe wrote: the crawler identity. The probe ran under the reference deployment's own User-Agent and that string names a private business, so it has been rewritten here to this repository's default. It changes no verdict - every robots.txt in this file answered out of its `*` group, which is the group any identity would have matched. Note on one field: matchingItems was counted with the keyword filter as it stood when the probe ran, which was before the same-day proximity rule (NEAR in src/sources/publishers.mjs) was added; it is left exactly as recorded and is therefore an upper bound on what today filter would keep. Every other number here is a fact about the network on 2026-09-11.
